text: Art therapy has gained increasing attention as an adjunctive intervention for cancer patients. This study sought to conduct the first network meta-analysis (NMA) to evaluate the effects of various art therapies on the psychological well-being and quality of life in cancer survivors, rank various interventions by efficacy, and provide evidence-based guidance for clinical practice.
source_label: Effects of different art therapies on the psychological well-being and quality of life in cancer survivors: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
